# Data dictionary

Every table and field, generated from [`backend/app/schema.py`](../backend/app/schema.py). The same definitions create the database (Alembic), order the CSV columns, and drive the enum and required-field checks in validation.

## Conventions

- **Money** is an integer number of **paise** (1 INR = 100 paise), in `*_paise` columns (`bigint`). There is no floating-point money anywhere.
- **Dates** are calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`); the simulation is day-granular. Timestamps appear only in operational tables and are UTC.
- **IDs** are immutable, zero-padded and carry their parents; the format of every primary key is in the table below and is checked by validation (check C1).
- **Required / optional**: optional fields may be empty (`NULL`); everything else must be present.
- **Allowed values** are enforced twice: by a `CHECK` constraint in the database and by validation (check C3).
- **Ground truth** (`gt.ground_truth`) lives in its own schema and folder and is never joined into an input table.

| `requires_international` | boolean | required |  |  |  |  | Student must be international |

| `award_bp` | integer | optional |  | basis points |  | 1..10000 when PERCENT | Percent of eligible fees, in basis points |
| `award_fixed_paise` | bigint | optional |  | paise |  | > 0 when FIXED | Fixed award amount |
| `priority` | smallint | required |  |  | unique |  | Tie-break order (lower wins) |

| `entity_id` | string(64) | required |  |  |  |  | Primary key of the affected entity |
| `student_id` | string(32) | required |  |  |  |  | Student |
| `expected_decision` | string(24) | required | `REVERSE_ALLOCATION`, `CAP_SCHOLARSHIP`, `VOID_DUPLICATE`, `BLOCK_REFUND`, `RECOMPUTE_BALANCE` |  |  |  | Expected fix |
| `expected_value_paise` | bigint | optional |  | paise |  |  | Correct figure |
| `details` | string(300) | required |  |  |  |  | How the case was built |

## app_user

AppUser: a login and its role.

**Relationships:** `app_user.program_id -> program.program_id (N:1 optional)`; `app_user.student_id -> student.student_id (N:1 optional)`

**Table rules:** `(role = 'LEARNER') = (student_id IS NOT NULL)`

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed values | Unit | Uniqueness | Validation rule | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app_user_id` | string(32) | required |  |  | primary key | USR-NNNNNN | Login id |
| `email` | string(80) | required |  |  | unique |  | Login email |
| `password_hash` | string(200) | required |  |  |  |  | scrypt hash, never the password |
| `role` | string(16) | required | `LEARNER`, `INSTRUCTOR`, `ACADEMIC_ADMIN`, `SUPPORT`, `PLATFORM_ADMIN` |  |  |  | Role |
| `student_id` | string(32) | optional |  |  |  |  | Student the login belongs to (LEARNER) |
| `program_id` | string(32) | optional |  |  |  |  | Program the login is limited to (INSTRUCTOR) |
| `enabled` | boolean | required |  |  |  |  | Disabled logins are rejected on every request |
| `created_at` | timestamp (UTC) | required |  |  |  |  | Creation time (UTC) |

## idempotency_key

IdempotencyKey: a retried write returns the first answer instead of writing twice.

**Relationships:** `idempotency_key.app_user_id -> app_user.app_user_id (N:1)`

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed values | Unit | Uniqueness | Validation rule | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app_user_id` | string(32) | required |  |  | part of primary key |  | Caller |
| `key` | string(80) | required |  |  | part of primary key |  | Client supplied Idempotency-Key |
| `request_hash` | string(64) | required |  |  |  |  | SHA-256 of the request body |
| `response_json` | json | required |  |  |  |  | Stored response replayed on a retry |
| `created_at` | timestamp (UTC) | required |  |  |  |  | Creation time (UTC) |

## exception

Exception: detector output, worked by support staff. Never reads ground truth.

**Relationships:** `exception.resolved_by -> app_user.app_user_id (N:1 optional)`; `exception.student_id -> student.student_id (N:1)`

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed values | Unit | Uniqueness | Validation rule | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exception_id` | string(32) | required |  |  | primary key | EXC-NNNNNN | Exception id |
| `exception_type` | string(30) | required | `ALLOC_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT`, `SCHOLARSHIP_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE`, `DUPLICATE_INVOICE`, `REFUND_EXCEEDS_NET_PAID`, `BALANCE_LEDGER_MISMATCH` |  |  |  | What the detector found |
| `entity_type` | string(20) | required | `enrollment`, `invoice`, `eligibility`, `scholarship`, `payment`, `refund`, `student_balance`, `exception` |  |  |  | Kind of entity |
| `entity_id` | string(64) | required |  |  |  |  | Primary key of the entity |
| `student_id` | string(32) | required |  |  |  |  | Student |
| `expected_paise` | bigint | optional |  | paise |  |  | What the rules say the figure should be |
| `found_paise` | bigint | optional |  | paise |  |  | What the data holds |
| `recommended_decision` | string(24) | required | `REVERSE_ALLOCATION`, `CAP_SCHOLARSHIP`, `VOID_DUPLICATE`, `BLOCK_REFUND`, `RECOMPUTE_BALANCE` |  |  |  | Suggested fix |
| `status` | string(10) | required | `OPEN`, `RESOLVED`, `DISMISSED` |  |  |  | Work state |
| `note` | string(400) | optional |  |  |  |  | Resolution note |
| `resolved_by` | string(32) | optional |  |  |  |  | Who closed it |
| `created_at` | timestamp (UTC) | required |  |  |  |  | Creation time (UTC) |
| `resolved_at` | timestamp (UTC) | optional |  |  |  |  | Resolution time (UTC) |

## Lifecycle states and allowed transitions

Each change writes an `event` row. Validation (check C6) replays the events and fails on any transition not listed here.

| Entity | From | Allowed next states |
|---|---|---|
| enrollment | (creation) | ENROLLED |
| enrollment | ENROLLED | CANCELLED, COMPLETED, WITHDRAWN |
| invoice | (creation) | ISSUED |
| invoice | ISSUED | CANCELLED, OVERDUE, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, VOID |
| invoice | PARTIALLY_PAID | CANCELLED, OVERDUE, PAID |
| invoice | OVERDUE | CANCELLED, PAID |
| invoice | PAID | CANCELLED |
| eligibility | (creation) | ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE |
| scholarship | (creation) | AWARDED |
| scholarship | AWARDED | APPLIED, REVOKED |
| scholarship | APPLIED | REVOKED |
| payment | (creation) | RECEIVED |
| payment | RECEIVED | ALLOCATED, PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED |
| payment | PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED | ALLOCATED |
| payment | ALLOCATED | PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED |
| refund | (creation) | APPROVED |
| refund | APPROVED | PAID |
| exception | (creation) | OPEN |
| exception | OPEN | DISMISSED, RESOLVED |
